topic: 流程说明与学术阶段复测
grammarFocus: 被动语态；顺序连接词；定语从句与分词短语的辨认。
title: Campus Library Orientation: Book Return and Academic Re-test
instructions: 本材料为模拟练习，非官方雅思试题。听录音前先阅读题目，听第一遍时抓住大意，听第二遍时注意细节。所有答案均来自录音原文。
transcript: Good morning, everyone. Welcome to the campus library orientation. My name is Sarah, and I'm the head librarian. Today, I'll explain the book return process, which is important for all new students. First, you need to return books to the main desk on the first floor. The desk is staffed from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays. Second, when you return a book, it is checked by a librarian. If the book is damaged, a fine will be added to your account. Third, you must return books by the due date, which is printed on the receipt. If you are late, a fine of 50 cents per day is charged. Fourth, you can renew books online, but only twice. After that, the book must be returned. Fifth, if you lose a book, you must pay the full price plus a processing fee. Now, let me explain the academic stage re-test. This test is taken by all students at the end of each semester. It covers the material from the whole term. The test is marked by two teachers, and the results are posted online within a week. You need to score at least 60% to pass. If you fail, you can retake the test once. The retake is scheduled two weeks after the original test. Now, are there any questions? Yes, the student in the back? Student: Thank you, Sarah. I have a question about the re-test. Is the re-test the same as the original test? Sarah: No, the re-test is different. It is designed to cover the same material but with different questions. Student: And how long is the re-test? Sarah: The re-test lasts two hours, just like the original test. Student: Can we use a dictionary during the test? Sarah: No, dictionaries are not allowed. Only a pen and your student ID are permitted. Student: What if I am sick on the day of the test? Sarah: If you are sick, you must provide a doctor's note. Then you can take the test at a later date. Student: Thank you. That's very helpful. Sarah: You're welcome. Are there any more questions? No? Then enjoy your semester, and remember to return your books on time!

grammar.title: 被动语态；顺序连接词；定语从句与分词短语的辨认
grammar.explanation: 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者，结构为be+过去分词。顺序连接词如first, second, third等用于组织步骤。定语从句用who, which, that等引导，修饰名词；分词短语用现在分词或过去分词短语作定语或状语。
grammar.example: The test is marked by two teachers, and the results are posted online within a week.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The books ______ by the librarian every evening.
questions.explanation: 主语books是复数，被动语态用are checked。
questions.evidence: The books are checked by the librarian every evening.

questions.prompt: Which word is a sequence connector?
questions.explanation: First是顺序连接词，表示第一步。
questions.evidence: First, you need to return books to the main desk.

questions.prompt: Identify the relative clause in: 'The desk, which is on the first floor, is staffed from 8 a.m.'
options: which is on the first floor
answers: which is on the first floor
questions.explanation: which is on the first floor是定语从句，修饰The desk。
questions.evidence: The desk, which is on the first floor, is staffed from 8 a.m.

questions.prompt: Identify the participial phrase in: 'The student sitting in the back asked a question.'
questions.explanation: sitting in the back是现在分词短语，修饰The student。
questions.evidence: The student sitting in the back asked a question.
